# Facebook/Meta Ads Library Scraper API - Winning Ads, Scam Check

> Apify actor anshumanatrey/facebook-ads-library-api. Scrapes the Facebook Ads Library, now called the Meta Ad Library (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, Threads, Audience Network ads), with no login, cookies or Meta API token. Returns one row per ad with advertiser, days running, number of versions, text, headline, call to action, landing URL and domain, image and video links, platforms, and the spend, impressions and EU audience data Meta publishes. Also an advertiser lead list and a brand scam check. $0.0007 per ad ($0.70 per 1,000), $0.008 per advertiser, $0.002 per brand scam-check ad, no start fee.

## When to use it
- Find competitors' winning ads: ads running 30+ days (minDaysRunning) and ads with several live versions (versions).
- Weekly competitor watchlists and swipe files for agencies and creative strategists.
- Lead lists of businesses advertising on a keyword now (mode advertisers).
- Brand protection: ads using a brand name from pages that are not the brand's own, with risk and signals (mode impersonation).
- Feeding ad data to n8n, Make, Zapier, Python, JavaScript or an AI agent (Apify MCP server).

## Inputs
- mode: ads (default) | pages | advertisers | impersonation
- searchTerms: keywords, one per line (commas split); a pasted Ad Library search link works; for impersonation, the brand
- pages: Facebook page links, page ids or names (mode pages)
- country: ALL (worldwide, default), a country name or an ISO code
- maxAds: ads saved per search (default 100)
- status: active | inactive | all; adType: all | political | housing | employment | credit; mediaType: all | image | video | meme | none
- minDaysRunning, exactPhrase, groupVersions, sortBy (impressions | relevance), officialPages (impersonation)

## Output fields (ad row)
adId, adLibraryUrl, pageName, pageId, pageUrl, pageLikes, pageVerified (true or null; Meta's ad search does not report it), isActive, startDate, endDate, daysRunning, versions, versionGroupId, platforms, adText, headline, description, callToAction, callToActionType, landingUrl, landingDomain, imageUrls, videoUrls, thumbnailUrls, cards, languages, adType, categories, spend, impressions, reach, audienceSize, ageGender, regions, targeting, fundingEntity, disclaimer, beneficiaryPayers, searchTerm, country, impersonation {brand, risk, signals, officialPageIds}, scrapedAt.
Advertiser row: pageName, pageId, pageUrl, pageLikes, adsInLibraryUrl, adsFound, activeAds, firstAdStarted, longestRunningDays, platforms, landingDomains, sampleAdUrl, sampleAdText, searchTerm, country.

## Price comparison (Apify free plan, per 1,000 ads, 2026-09-25)
- This actor: $0.70, no start fee.
- apify/facebook-ads-scraper (6,040 users a month): $5.80.
- curious_coder/facebook-ads-library-scraper (5,853): $0.75 + $0.00005 per run.
- igolaizola/facebook-ad-library-scraper (1,048): $0.75 + $0.0075 per run.
- automation-lab/facebook-ads-library (458): $0.575 + $0.005 per run (cheaper than this actor above about 40 ads per run).
- memo23/facebook-ads-library-scraper-ppe (340): $0.50 + $0.05 per run (cheaper above about 250 ads per run).
- jmlp/meta-ad-library-scraper (254): $0.15 + platform usage paid by the user.

## Facts
- Meta rate-limits Apify's own IPs and the datacenter proxy to 0 ads (tested 2026-09-25); every search runs on Apify's residential proxy, included in the price.
- Tested on Apify 2026-09-25: 200 ads in 106 s; 3 keywords x 50 ads in 49 s (run at once); 256 MB (peak 57-70 MB).
- Charged only for rows saved; a spending limit stops the run between batches.
- Built on the MIT library meta-ads-collector (Meta's public Ad Library GraphQL).
